description: Displays PuntoSeguro's life-insurance quote form, in which the user types an exact date of birth and chooses a coverage amount; submitting it shows the quotes available through PuntoSeguro. Optionally preselects a coverage amount. Sends and stores no personal data. Residents of Spain only.

coverage_amount_eur.description: Coverage amount in euros to preselect, only if the user already stated or calculated one

name: open_life_insurance_quote_form

anyOf.description: Requested life-insurance coverage amount in euros

title: Open life-insurance quote form
